scenes.a: Welcome to The Provision Table today.
Come and bring your daily work, your hard decisions, and your pressing needs before the Father.
As God's Word declares in Proverbs 16:3, Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established.
When you place your plans, your labor, and your quiet anxieties into His faithful hands, He aligns your mind with His divine wisdom.
Lord Heavenly Father, we surrender every effort, every project, and every daily financial concern to You.
Establish our thoughts, clear our path, and open doors of supernatural wisdom and daily provision.
May our work bring glory to Your holy name as You direct our steps.
Subscribe now to walk with us in God's daily provision today.
